facts.statement: Oceanotitan is a sauropod dinosaur genus known from the Upper Jurassic Lourinhã Formation in Portugal.
facts.quote: Oceanotitan (meaning "ocean giant") is a genus of sauropod dinosaur known from the Upper Jurassic (latest Kimmeridgian stage, about 149 million years ago) Lourinhã Formation of Portugal.

facts.statement: The genus is represented by a single specimen containing several tail vertebrae and appendicular bones.
facts.quote: It is represented by a single specimen consisting of several tail vertebrae and appendicular bones.

facts.statement: The genus contains a single species, Oceanotitan dantasi.
facts.quote: It contains one species, Oceanotitan dantasi.

facts.statement: The holotype specimen, SHN 181, is stored at the Sociedade de História Natural in Torres Vedras, Portugal.
facts.quote: The holotype and only specimen of Oceanotitan, SHN 181, is stored at the Sociedade de História Natural, in Torres Vedras, Portugal.

facts.statement: The fossil was discovered at the coastal cliffs of Praia de Valmitão in Lourinhã by a private collector.
facts.quote: It was discovered at the coastal cliffs of Praia de Valmitão in Lourinhã, by a private collector who donated his collection to the municipality of Torres Vedras.

facts.statement: The genus was formally described in 2019 by Pedro Mocho and colleagues.
facts.quote: It was formally described in 2019 by Pedro Mocho, the author of the thesis, and colleagues.

facts.statement: The generic name Oceanotitan means "ocean giant" and refers to the Atlantic Ocean location and Greek mythology.
facts.quote: The generic name Oceanotitan ("ocean giant") derives its name from oceanus, the Latin word for ocean, since it was found at the base of a cliff overlooking the Atlantic Ocean, and the giant Titans from Greek mythology.

facts.statement: Oceanotitan has unique features separating it from other macronarians, including a sagittal groove on the first tail vertebra, lateral depressions on tail vertebrae, and an elliptical concavity on the scapula.
facts.quote: Oceanotitan possesses unique features that separate it from all other macronarians, which are: a sagittal groove on the top of the first caudal vertebral neural spines; lateral depressions on the edges of the anterior and middle caudal vertebral neural spines while being dorsally connected in the posterior-most ones; and an elliptical concavity on the bottom of the scapular blade, near the acromion process.

facts.statement: The total body size of Oceanotitan is uncertain due to the lack of complete remains.
facts.quote: Total body size is uncertain due to lack of remains.

facts.statement: Oceanotitan lived in a river system environment rather than a marine one.
facts.quote: The Praia da Amoreira-Porto Novo Member of the Lourinha Formation, from where Oceanotitan is known, was deposited in a river system, but not a marine environment, based on the species of palynomorph found there.

facts.statement: The ecosystem where Oceanotitan lived had flora and fauna similar to those of the Morrison Formation and Tendaguru Formation.
facts.quote: Its flora and fauna are similar to the Morrison Formation in the United States, and the Tendaguru Formation in Tanzania.

facts.statement: Oceanotitan lived alongside various theropods, sauropods, a stegosaur, and an ornithopod.
facts.quote: Oceanotitan lived alongside species of the predatory theropods Ceratosaurus, Compsognathus, Lourinhanosaurus, Torvosaurus, and an indeterminate species of abelisaurid, the sauropods Lourinhasaurus, Lusotitan, Zby and an indeterminate species of diplodocid, the stegosaur Miragaia, and the ornithopod Hypsilophodon.

facts.statement: Oceanotitan dantasi lived during the Late Jurassic Kimmeridgian stage, approximately 152 million years ago, in what is now Europe.
facts.quote: Oceanotitan dantasi es la única especie conocida del género extinto Oceanotitan de dinosaurio saurópodo titanosauriforme, que vivió a finales del período Jurásico, hace aproximadamente 152 millones de años en el Kimmeridgiense, en lo que es hoy Europa.

facts.statement: Oceanotitan lived between 152.21 and 149.2 million years ago during the Kimmeridgian stage.
facts.quote: Time range: Kimmeridgian to Kimmeridgian (152.21 to 149.2 million years ago)

facts.statement: Oceanotitan is classified within the unranked family Titanosauriformes.
